0022600116.text: The LA Clippers (1-1, 2nd in the Pacific and one game back, 7th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) for their third game of the season, after a loss in their most recent game and a 0-1 road record so far. Bradley Beal, Jordan Miller, Max Strus and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are out for the Clippers, while Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh and Thomas Sorber are out for the Thunder. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 128-110 loss in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
